facts.statement: Works requested from the check-out report: two lounge spotlights not working and water damage to a lounge ceiling tile at Flat 8, 168 Alder Lane, Kingshaven, ZZ4 3ZZ.
Contractor quoted £198.37 plus VAT to replace two spotlights and one ceiling board.
Agency put that quote to the landlord; the landlord replied 'Pls go ahead' on 28 Sep 2025 — the only landlord message on file.
Invoice on file is from supplier 'Willow Homes' for £200.00 + £40.00 VAT = £240.00, line description 'Change spot light bulbs, replace ceiling tile'.
The instructed provider is addressed as 'Clarke' in the agency's own emails; a reply at event-023 is attributed to 'Harriet'.
Property is not tenanted; keys for the visit were held by the caretaker and no key return is recorded.
Check-out report records the general detector entry as 'Tested? No', despite boilerplate stating alarms will have been checked.
Contractor reported invoice and photos sent on 8 Oct 2025; the agency nonetheless recorded documents skipped for 'No before and after photos'.
Invoice was emailed to the landlord for payment on 8 Oct 2025 and the request was closed the same day, with landlord confirmation still flagged as needed.

conflicts.description: Approved amount (£198.37 + VAT = £238.04) vs invoiced amount (£240.00 incl. VAT).
conflicts.resolution: Payment put on hold with the landlord; contractor asked to explain; decision referred to the property manager.

conflicts.description: Payee identity: invoice supplier 'Willow Homes' vs instructed contractor 'Clarke' (and 'Harriet' at event-023).
conflicts.resolution: Contractor asked to confirm trading entity; no payment until verified.

conflicts.description: Scope: approval covered replacing two spotlights and one ceiling board; invoice describes changing spotlight bulbs and replacing a ceiling tile.
Photos: contractor says photos were sent; agency recorded them as skipped/not held.
Check-out report inspection/appointment date 25 August 2026 vs assessor signature 27 September 2025.
conflicts.resolution: Recorded as a data-quality issue for the office.

red_flags.description: Invoice payee ('Willow Homes') differs from the instructed contractor and the total exceeds the approved quote; invoice already sent to the landlord for payment.
red_flags.action_taken: Landlord asked to hold payment (ACT-3); contractor asked to confirm entity and amount (ACT-2); referred to property manager. No money moved (PRO-PAYMENTS).

red_flags.description: Provider named inconsistently across the file (Clarke / Harriet); property described as a 'studio' in agency emails while the record says Flat 8; check-out report dated 2026 but signed 2025.
red_flags.action_taken: Recorded in the case note (ACT-1) and the handover card.

red_flags.description: Check-out report detector line 'Tested? No' — smoke/CO alarm test not evidenced before re-let of an untenanted flat.
red_flags.action_taken: Flagged to the landlord (ACT-3) and in the handover; test to be arranged before re-let. No hazard reported or observed.
